decision.reason: Application input loss and contract gaps are established; training necessity is not established.
decision.next_phase: Repair typed semantic projection, manifest contracts and coherent per-file prompts; repeat complete governed qualification, then compare coding models before deciding on targeted fine-tuning.
decision.s67_evaluator: Not exercised by this diagnosis; no quality or retraining conclusion is drawn about its trained adapter.

findings.summary: The recursive semantic projection drops source_screen_id, trigger_element_id, target_screen_id, entry_screen_id, architecture connection endpoints, traceability IDs/codes and ADR context text.
findings.interpretation: Approved snapshots remain intact, but model-visible content loses semantic relationships. A different target_screen_id produces exactly the same projection. This is an application defect independent of model training.
findings.next_action: Replace key-name filtering with typed projection preserving graph relationships and stable readable aliases; keep architectural decision context.

findings.summary: All four retained final manifests put UI/main consumers before their dependencies and describe interfaces in prose. Scala omits the requested independently executable test. These plans passed source-plan admission.
findings.interpretation: Source publication validates lineage and file boundaries, not coherent public APIs or executable test coverage. The current schema cannot require a usable dependency graph or exact signatures.
findings.next_action: Validate manifest roles, public signatures, dependencies and test presence before child generation; retain exact rejected output instead of silently rewriting plans.

findings.summary: All 19 historical and 32 diagnostic requests terminated with STOP below the selected output budget. Historical files use 99-374 tokens and 10-43 lines; diagnostic files use 51-371 tokens and 6-37 lines.
findings.interpretation: Budget exhaustion does not explain these retained failures. Increasing max output to 2200 did not restore the tested Web or Java behavior. This does not exclude indirect effects of formatting or brevity instructions.
findings.next_action: Do not treat a larger token cap as a demonstrated fix.

findings.summary: The two baseline Java Main replays compile but print Usage with zero arguments. Both focused-instruction replays compile and print a reservation UUID without arguments, using identical frozen domain/service source bytes.
findings.interpretation: The same model weights can satisfy this specific launcher behavior after a prompt change. The two focused outputs are byte-identical; this is one task with two calls, not an estimate of model quality.
findings.next_action: Remove conflicting instructions and provide explicit per-file contracts before comparing models or training.

findings.summary: None of eight Web replays exports createReservation for Node; focused Web scripts import but return an empty module. Kotlin focused outputs both omit the final class brace. Scala focused sample 09 still extends App; sample 23 contains def main outside the body of object Main.
findings.interpretation: Lexical markers and valid JSON are insufficient. Scala sample 25 also has a main signature only in object Interaction, plus duplicate domain/service definitions and a malformed string. No diagnostic Kotlin or Scala compile success is claimed.
findings.next_action: Use compiler/test results and exact failing interfaces as repair feedback, with bounded audited attempts.

findings.summary: The historical governed Web TEST phase was a smoke check; generated Node tests were evaluated separately and failed. This phase probes individual files and leaves all application-level qualification claims false.
findings.interpretation: Passing a schema, an import check or one CLI probe must not be promoted into thesis application evidence. Synthetic artifacts and known failing files are not held-out evaluation cases.
findings.next_action: Define independent acceptance checks from approved requirements; qualify complete applications only after all required checks pass.

execution_scope.generated_file_substitution: One diagnostic file substituted only in a separate disposable read-only workspace; no original artifact overwritten.

validation.reason: Only diagnostic operators, their tests and this report are added; production sources are unchanged.

limitations: Selected known failing development files, not held-out tasks or independent application samples.
FOCUSED_INSTRUCTION is a task-specific prompt intervention, not a proven general repair.
OMIT_ARCHITECTURE removes approved semantic content solely for an explicit diagnostic ablation.
Two stochastic repetitions cannot establish population pass rates or training necessity.
No database writes, governed source publication, evaluator inference or frozen-case access.
Probe scope and interventions were specified before inference; executable probe code was finalized after inference began. This is exploratory diagnosis, not a preregistered benchmark.
No per-call paired model seed; order is seeded, sampling remains stochastic. Small samples do not identify population effect sizes.
Scala explicit_main_signature is a lexical observation and does not prove binding to object Main; manual review found that sample 23 is not bound to Main.
Kotlin and Scala diagnostic outputs were not compiled; previous phase retained their original governed failures.
No quantization, output-format or alternative-model ablation was performed. Correcting application inputs precedes such comparisons.
The full synthetic application is not qualified by the successful focused Java Main probe; its original JUnit test defects remain.

harness_corrections.issue: Initial diagnostic function name shadowed http package before network access.
First projection collision check used nonexistent to_screen_id; replaced by a counterexample changing the actual target_screen_id.
Java image declares an implicit Gradle cache volume; pre-start verification rejected it.
harness_corrections.resolution: Explicit tmpfs cache, retained initial preflight receipt, removed the created anonymous volume, and completed checks-v2 without new inference.

reference_context.use: Primary model identity and non-thinking model documentation; not a substitute for local quality evidence.
Token masking enforces output grammar; source-program semantic correctness remains separately checked.
Generation parameter documentation; local retained usage and STOP observations drive the budget conclusion.

artifact_index_scope: All existing diagnostic files before this index and final report; index and report hashes are verified separately.
